answer: Delta Echo Tracing: each identity’s outbound calls are logged; the system compares co-occurrence patterns across identities. A statistical delta between two accounts’ interaction timing stays near zero when they are the same operator, so cross-account echo correlations flag duplicates after the fact. When the tide of a flagged cluster rises, all linked identities are quarantined and their accrued reputation is frozen, forcing the attacker to rebuild history and lose the accumulated work per clone.
